definitions.explanation: A place where two roads cross, forming four corners. Used when giving directions or describing locations in a neighborhood.

examples.japanese: {四|よ}つ{角|かど}を{右|みぎ}に{曲|ま}がる。
あの{四|よ}つ{角|かど}にコンビニがある。
examples.english: There is a convenience store at that intersection.

examples.japanese: {次|つぎ}の{四|よ}つ{角|かど}を{左|ひだり}に{曲|ま}がると、{駅|えき}が{見|み}えてきます。
examples.english: If you turn left at the next intersection, you will see the station.

notes:
USAGE:
A common word in everyday directions. Refers specifically to a four-way intersection where streets cross at roughly right angles. More colloquial and specific than {交差点|こうさてん}, which is the general term for any intersection.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {四|よ}つ{角|かど}を{曲|ま}がる (to turn at the intersection)
- {四|よ}つ{角|かど}の{手前|てまえ} (just before the intersection)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {交差点|こうさてん}: intersection — the standard, slightly more formal term for any road crossing
- {十字路|じゅうじろ}: crossroads — literally "cross-shaped road," more formal
